name: Mento South African Rand
oneLiner: ZARm is Mento's South African rand stablecoin on Celo, minted CDP-style against USDm collateral (Mento V3, a Liquity v2 fork).
collateral: Mento V3 Liquity-v2-style CDPs collateralized by USDm; USDm in turn is backed by the diversified Mento Reserve mix (sUSDS, CELO, EURC, USDC, USDT, axlEUROC, stETH, and smaller positions exposed via the Mento reserve dashboard).
pegMechanism: Mento V3 oracle-priced FX stablecoin minted by depositing USDm as CDP collateral and borrowing ZARm against it; user-set interest rates, Stability Pool liquidations, and Liquity-style redemptions support the ZARm peg, with circuit breakers and Mento reserve transparency on the upstream USDm leg.

oracleRisk.summary: Mento V3 routes rates through SortedOracles and OracleAdapter, while BreakerBox rejects stale, out-of-bounds, or off-hours feeds before swaps/CDP routes use them.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: ZARm inherits upstream freeze exposure because the Mento reserve mix includes tracked freezable stablecoins such as USDC, USDT, and EURC.

mintAuthority.summary: ZARm uses StableTokenV2 with minting restricted to broker/validator paths; the token owner is the Mento Timelock (2-day delay, MentoGovernor as sole proposer, open executor). BorrowerOperations is immutable.

controls.label: Mento BorrowerOperations (immutable CDP minter)
controls.capDescription: ZARm mints only against USDm CDP collateral; BorrowerOperations has no owner() and no EIP-1967 proxy slot — immutable.
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69291577, BorrowerOperations 0x8ec9A81871F816F1EF007a82293703057A943B8A: 46358-byte code, owner() empty, EIP-1967 slots zero — immutable. Prior read also confirmed ZARm broker() = 0x777A8255cA72412f0d706dc03C9D1987306B4CaD.

controls.label: Mento Timelock (ZARm token owner)
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69291577, ZARm owner() = 0x890DB8A597940165901372Dd7DB61C9f246e2147; confirmed Timelock (getMinDelay() = 172800); hasRole(PROPOSER_ROLE, MentoGovernor 0x47036...) = true; hasRole(EXECUTOR_ROLE, 0x0) = true (open executor).

review.evidence: At Celo block 69291577: ZARm owner() = Mento Timelock 0x890DB... (confirmed TimelockController, not a Safe or EOA); getMinDelay() = 172800s; MentoGovernor is sole PROPOSER; BorrowerOperations confirmed immutable. All addressable mint surfaces confirmed.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: ZARm has one tracked Celo deployment and reviewed Mento docs describe obtaining Mento stables on Celo. No durable cross-chain route was verified for this asset, so it is triaged as single-chain/native.
